selection_method.picker_change_this_round: added load_worker_attempted(), which harvests every address from every round-N/claim.json (list-valued keys ending in 'addresses', since round claims use chosen_addresses / assigned_addresses / claimed_addresses), so rounds 9+ are excluded automatically instead of by a hand-edited ATTEMPTED set. Primary's live claim is still re-read at run time via load_primary_reserved().
screening_rules: unregistered, not in primary's live claim, not attempted by any worker-b round
body must open with addiu sp,sp,-N (a real frame push) and contain at least one sd/ld
no COP1/CO2, no 64-bit multiply (op 0x2d), no bltz/bgez forms
integer-only leaves and small call/branch functions preferred: round 6 showed frameless sibling-call thunks are unreachable on this compiler, round 7-9 showed framed bodies reproduce well
selection_method.rationale: Round 9 demonstrated two reusable levers (assign a dereference result back into the parameter to pin it to $a0; trailing asm volatile("") to defeat sibling-call rewriting), so the round-10 batch leans on framed virtual-call thunks and small accessor pairs while avoiding the frameless thunk class.

verification_method: r10_dump_orig.py re-reads the ELF, checks its sha256, checks each [address, end) range against /root/kh2fm-build/layout.tsv, and records a per-range sha256; --disasm additionally runs the pinned ee-objdump inside image kh2-local/ps2-compiler:3.2-ee-040921-objdiff. Proof of match is probe_fm_source.py against the original ELF bytes.
compiler_use: Read-only through the shared probe harness (Public/tools/kh2-audit/probe_fm_source.py). No compiler-flag changes, no hand-rolled ee-g++ runs, no shared-stage writes.
isolation_statement: Worker B owns only its own claim/report files and its own recovery-experiments sources. Active sources, functions.tsv, layout.tsv, stage sync, full builds, manifests, receipts, Ghidra export and HANDOFF.md remain primary's.

003068d8.mechanism: four parameters, so the forwarded object reaches $a3; `func_00305650(param_4); asm volatile("sync"); asm volatile("ei"); return 0;` - bare intrinsics land exactly where Ghidra shows them

0018f858.mechanism: `u32 uVar1 = func_001a4550(*param_1, param_1[1]); *param_1 = uVar1;` - reusing the parameter as the store base gives the target's two loads off s0

001b81e8.mechanism: `func_001b7f88(); DAT_003511c1 = 1; return PTR_003511b8;` - the byte store needs a u8 global; both symbols declared at the true address 0x35...

002f1898.mechanism: same shape with the symbol re-derived from the raw word: target `lui 0x1e3` / `lw 0xc0d0` means DAT_01e3c190 = 0x1e3c0d0, not Ghidra's 0x1e2c0d0 (ee-objdump's printed displacement -16176 disagrees with the encoded 0xc0d0 = -16192)

002b81ec.reason: target uses the s8 leaf frame-pointer idiom (sd s8; move s8,sp; ...; move sp,s8; ld s8) which GCC 3.2 never emits from C - the same class blocked round-7 002b99a0 and round-8 002b6ab8; the original build evidently used -fno-omit-frame-pointer for some translation units

002b8214.reason: byte-identical to 002b81ec; same s8 leaf frame-pointer idiom

0030ec28.measured: 40/40 with 3 differing words at best; v02 48/40
0030ec28.reason: target keeps `lui v1,0x1; and v0,v0,v1; sltu v0,zero,v0` as an explicit mask test; GCC 3.2 strength-reduces the constant into a dsll/andi bit test

00315418.reason: the target keeps an unreachable `jal 0x3166f0` behind a plain branch; GCC deletes provably dead calls

003155c0.reason: target builds the constant with lui+ori (0x3785f8) where GCC wants addiu; v02 marking the trailing callee noreturn did not resolve it

0016fb00.reason: Ghidra's `(**(code**)*DAT)` hides one vtable level; corrected to `*(code *)(*(u32 *)DAT + off)` in v02

001231f8.reason: arguments passed in $9/$10/$11 (t1/t2/t3), not an O32 argument register set - not expressible in C
